text:
Edit this complete sprite. Keep the far gripping hand and entire low diagonal Kingdom Key exactly in place and unchanged. Keep Sora's head, torso, legs, boots, canvas framing and smooth KH2 finish unchanged.




The EMPTY near/front hand is currently extended far out to screen-right. Bring it close to the weapon by bending that front elbow: its forearm crosses gently inward across the lower torso, pointing down-left, and the empty gloved hand floats immediately beside the SCREEN-RIGHT edge of the gold guard. Leave a small visible gap of about one finger width between the empty fingers and the guard. The empty hand is near the waist, slightly below the gripping hand; fingers lightly curled. It does NOT grip or touch the handle. The front shoulder and elbow stay natural and connected, wrist unflipped. The far hand ALONE still grips the black handle. Exactly two complete hands and arms.




This is a small hand-release pose before shoulder lifting, so do not rotate/lengthen/redesign the weapon, move the soles or change the camera. Render ONE finished full character/weapon image on white, with the same square placement and generous margins. No labels, effects, sheet or separate layers.
